WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    c.customer_id, 
    c.gender, 
    COUNT(o.order_id) as number_of_orders
  FROM Customers c
  LEFT JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender
),
gender_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    gender,
    COUNT(*) as customers_with_gender,
    SUM(number_of_orders) as total_orders_for_gender
  FROM customer_orders
  GROUP BY gender
),
customer_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    co.customer_id,
    co.gender,
    co.number_of_orders,
    CAST(co.number_of_orders AS FLOAT) / gs.total_orders_for_gender as share,
    (CAST(co.number_of_orders AS FLOAT) / gs.total_orders_for_gender) - (1.0 / gs.customers_with_gender) as gap
  FROM customer_orders co
  JOIN gender_stats gs ON co.gender = gs.gender
)
SELECT 
  customer_id,
  gender,
  number_of_orders,
  share,
  gap
FROM customer_shares
WHERE gap > 0
ORDER BY gap DESC, gap IS NULL, customer_id
LIMIT 10
